def radix_sort(arr):
    if not arr:
        return []
    # Separate negatives and positives
    neg = [-x for x in arr if x < 0]
    pos = [x for x in arr if x >= 0]
    # Sort both
    if neg:
        max_neg = max(neg)
        exp = 1
        while max_neg // exp > 0:
            counting_sort_by_digit(neg, exp)
            exp *= 10
        neg = [-x for x in reversed(neg)]
    if pos:
        max_pos = max(pos)
        exp = 1
        while max_pos // exp > 0:
            counting_sort_by_digit(pos, exp)
            exp *= 10
    return neg + pos
